name: Qruise
description: Qruise develops machine learning software for controlling, calibrating, and benchmarking quantum devices. Spun out of Forschungszentrum Jülich and co-founded by Tommaso Calarco, the company creates AI-driven digital twins of quantum systems that help physicists and engineers accelerate hardware development across quantum computing and sensing platforms.

products.name: Qruise Platform
products.description: AI-driven digital twin software for controlling, calibrating, and benchmarking quantum devices across computing and sensing platforms

highlights: Co-founded by Tommaso Calarco, a leading figure in European quantum control research
Spun out of Forschungszentrum Juelich with deep expertise in optimal quantum control
Creates machine learning digital twins to accelerate quantum hardware development cycles

sources.title: Qruise wants to build AI to automate quantum device development — TechCrunch
